summary: All 25 Lean files in the BooleanAnalysis directory contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, lemmas, theorems, and proofs formalizing Korten's improved mirror-set argument (ECCC TR26-221, 2026). The main surface files (Bernoulli.lean, CoordinateSampling.lean, Fibers.lean, HarmonicMean.lean, LightPatterns.lean, MirrorSets.lean) expose public APIs with documented theorem statements. Defs.lean files provide core definitions (Bernoulli weights, harmonic means, coordinate fibers, marginal masses, density limits). Internal/ files contain proof machinery: Bernoulli sampling laws, coordinate union/difference laws, entropy deficits and fiber lemmas, harmonic mean variational formulas and induction, light-patterns bounds via reciprocal-density Markov, mirror-set completion and guiding distributions. Every file contains executable Lean 4 code with mathematical statements and proofs; none are pure import aggregators or documentation-only. The three-layer architecture (Defs/Internal/surface) is consistently followed.
